name: BridgeData V2
summary: 大规模多任务真实机器人操作数据集，覆盖多种厨房和桌面场景。
summaryEn: A large real-robot multitask manipulation dataset spanning diverse kitchen and tabletop scenes.
scaleZh: 100 余项任务的 5 万余条轨迹
wmNote: 多任务、多场景和语言条件操作支持通用世界模型。
wmNoteEn: Multitask, multi-scene, and language-conditioned data support general world models.

evidence.statement: Official release provides robot trajectories, scripted rollouts and initial/final states with language annotations. Consolidate the older BridgeData record and remove unrelated paper links.
